settings.description: The lock settings of the project, as a JSON string.

isLocked.description: True when the article is frozen and read-only.

lockedBy.description: The user who froze the article.

lockedAt.description: The timestamp in milliseconds indicating the moment when the article was frozen. Stored as a unix timestamp at UTC.

version.description: The number of times the article was frozen.

resolvedBy.description: The user who resolved the ticket. Set by the workflow rule when the ticket becomes resolved.

resolvedAt.description: The timestamp in milliseconds indicating the moment when the ticket became resolved. Stored as a unix timestamp at UTC.
